{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}')

# Check for converted orders
converted = df[df['converted'] == 1]
print(f'Number of converted orders: {len(converted)}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
missing_age = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f'Number of customers with age = -1: {len(missing_age)}')"}
